_comment: Supplies bought at the General Store. use: what happens when used from the wagon (on a chosen hero, or on the wagon/lamp). Items are also curio keys.

food.name: Food
food.desc: Salt pork, hardtack and beans. The party eats 2 per trail stop, and more at camp.

bandages.name: Bandages
bandages.desc: Heals a hero 15% and stops bleeding.

antivenom.name: Antivenom
antivenom.desc: Cures poison. Useful on venomous things.

whiskey.name: Whiskey
whiskey.desc: A hero sheds 10 Fatigue. Also loosens tongues.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: For crates, strongboxes and anything nailed shut.

salt.name: Salt
salt.desc: Old wisdom says it keeps strange things at bay.

wagon_parts.name: Wagon Parts
wagon_parts.desc: A spare axle, wheel spokes and pins. Repairs the wagon by 30.
